children: Visa Inc. Class A (NYSE:V) posted strong Q3 results with $11.6B revenue and rising transactions while expanding into regulated stablecoin pilots and partnerships (Nium, Shinhan, Dunamu) to scale 24/7 cross-border settlement and payments, prompting Wolfe Research to raise its price target.
Visa Inc. Class A Revenue Growth
: Visa (V) Q3: revenue $11.6B (+14% YoY); processed 71.7B transactions (+10%); cross‑border ex‑EU +12%; value‑added services revenue +33%; adjusted net income $6.3B.
Visa Inc. Class A Cross-Border Stablecoins

: Visa Inc. Class A (V) joins MAS-led BLOOM pilot with Nium to test regulated USD/EUR stablecoins for cross-border settlement, aiming seven-day-a-week processing while keeping security and compliance.
Visa Inc. Class A Stablecoin Pilot Korea
: Visa (V) partners with Shinhan to pilot Visa’s enterprise stablecoin for issuance, remittances, redemptions and card-settlement tests, aiming to expand B2B and B2C payments in South Korea
: Wolfe Research maintained an Outperform rating on Visa Inc. Class A (V) and raised its price target for Visa Inc. Class A (V) from $435.00 to $460.00 per share.
Visa Inc. Class A Dunamu Partnership
: Visa Inc. Class A (V) partners with Dunamu to test stablecoin payments, cross-border remittances and AI-driven services using Dunamu’s crypto tech integrated with Visa’s payment network.
